summary: Tested new Photos-in-NoteModal + LLM Translate features on top of Iron Rabbit PWA. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass for POST /api/translate (happy Spanish, Japanese multiline preserves line breaks, empty text 400, empty target 400, >12k chars 413). Frontend: E2E Playwright script passed all requested flows — attachment-add-btn shows 'Attach photos · 0/10' in NoteModal, note-translate-btn correctly disabled when content empty and enabled after typing, translate-modal opens, Spanish translation renders in translate-result within ~15s, translate-copy-btn present, translate-append-btn appends content with '— Español (🇪🇸) —' separator and closes modal. FullScreen path also verified: fullscreen-translate-btn opens modal, target language switched to Français, translation appended, note saved and content persisted after close+reopen. Insights regression: header-insights opens insights-modal with all KPI cards. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY loaded — no 503s.
critical_code_review_comments: NoteModal.jsx: title Input and content Textarea do not have data-testid attributes (note-title-input / note-content-input). Tests currently rely on positional 'first input/textarea in dialog' selectors — fragile. Recommend adding data-testid for both.
NoteModal save/create button lacks a data-testid (note-save-btn / note-create-btn) — tests fall back to text 'Create'/'Save' which will break for i18n.
The note-modal 'Open fullscreen' button was located only by title*='ull screen'. Add data-testid='note-fullscreen-btn' for stable automation.
server.py /api/translate: exception path returns raw model error message truncated to 200 chars via HTTPException — fine, but consider logging request_id so upstream 502s can be correlated.
seed_data_creation: Playwright test created a 'Translate demo' note with Spanish+Français appended translations. Safe to leave; localStorage-scoped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend translate endpoint verified fully — pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_translate.py can be re-used. Frontend E2E confirmed both entry points (NoteModal + FullScreenNote) end-to-end incl. persistence. Quick Access wizard is dismissed via clicking 'Skip and never remind' text link on first launch. FAB testid is 'fab-add-note'. Note title/content inputs currently lack data-testid — recommended fix pending.
